_note: Hand-curated marquee / high-investment players per team (the EXPECTATION axis of salience). Tells Dan who the headliners are by investment — contract, free-agent signing, high draft pick, big trade, award, or franchise status — which a flat name+position roster can't convey. Injected as PLAYERS_TO_WATCH. Cross-checked against the live CURRENT_ROSTER in generate_rant.py before injection (entries not on the roster are dropped), so a player traded away can't be featured. FLAVOR/salience only — the safety judge does NOT cross-reference this; rule 11 (off-roster) is the factual guardrail. Update after a major trade/signing (the curate-key-players GitHub issue will remind you). basis values: franchise | contract | free_agent | draft | trade | award.
